prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: one isolated adult corpse sprite for the existing grimdark cyberpunk roguelike, to review before use. Reference 1 is the actual tiny player: match its readable coarse painted style and physical ADULT scale, never copy the living pose. Reference 2 is the accepted masked cultist and is a uniform/hood reference only for the cultist. Primary request: an unmistakably DEAD adult lying flat on the GROUND after combat. NOT upright, NOT sitting, NOT on a bed or chair, no pose stand, no pedestal. Draw the entire single body and its small irregular dried-dark-red blood stain as one complete transparent cutout, all feet, hands, cloth and blood fully inside generous empty margins. Orthogonal overhead game view with horizontal and vertical axes, not an isometric diamond and no dramatic camera. Export will be only 80 x 48 native pixels, adult head-to-toe approximately 58-68 native pixels comparable to the 64px standing player. Use rough hand-painted 1990s PC RPG readability: broad uneven angular color clusters, sparse controlled chipped highlights, worn faded cloth with a few deliberate torn shapes, asymmetry and natural collapsed weight. Contours remain legible but are not a pristine uniform vector stroke. 3-4 muted values per material, no polished illustrative finish, no smooth airbrush, glossy bevels, shiny pristine armor, embossed miniature, hyper-real microtexture or symmetrical presentation. A few dark crimson blood shapes and clothing damage; no explicit closeup mutilation, no exposed organs or genitals, no nudity, no lettering. Tiny contact shadow immediately beneath, otherwise truly TRANSPARENT background, no surrounding floor tile or scenery. Subject: a dead adult civilian in a faded grey-olive work coat and dusty brown trousers, black worn boots. Lying on the left side in a loose irregular diagonal, one knee flexed, one arm crumpled underneath, face turned down and partly hidden by clothing. Ordinary human proportions; no military equipment and no religious costume. Main silhouette must read collapsed human, not a pile of fabric.
